No saddle.
look: pony-sized stocky biped, bony pebbled dome skull ringed by cream spikes, small beak, short clawed arms, long stiff tail, cream-white hide with broad dusty-pink stripes, pinkish-red neck and back, tan lower legs,
texture_prompt: cream-white pebbled hide with broad dusty-pink and red vertical stripes on body and tail, pinkish-red scaly neck and back, grey-brown pebbled dome with cream spikes, tan scaly lower legs, dark claws, matte surface

eyes.note: on the skin at the painted amber eye, each side ray-cast (the Tripo head is 8 mm off the midline, so the dots are not mirrored); glTF Head-bone space

pipeline.mesh: Tripo P1 multiview (front + left cropped from the owner sheet), task 83150c87-1351-4ab3-9372-3f79f36f852c, 50 Tripo credits
pipeline.transplant_tool: tools/transplant_rig.py --leg 0.08,-0.07,0.22 0.1,-0.17,0.12 0.105,-0.21,0.012 0.105,-0.27,0.008 (the mesh crouches; the landmark warp put the hip 0.25 ahead of the thigh and 0.19 out)
pipeline.gaits: tools/gait/make_gait.py tools/gait/pachycephalosaurus.json: walk, run, strafe_left/right and walk_back from the walk plan

clips_from.tail: tools/gait/stiffen_tail.py --keep 0.35 on idle alert attack_primary attack_heavy hit_react feed charge (long stiff tail per the sheet)
clips_from.kick: none: a biped has no double hind kick; the brain only kicks when the clip exists

weights.toe_weights: three spatial smoothing passes; original bone assignments retained

authored_clips.knockdown: complete death collapse followed by 8-frame grounded hold
authored_clips.hit_react: dedicated 0.6s head/neck recoil from neutral idle; no death frames
authored_clips.death: coherent sideways collapse with small neck release; corrected to ground each frame
